title: Reduced bearing to Whole circle bearing

data.title: Reduced bearing to Whole circle bearing
data.solution:
rb = input()
directions = {"N": 0, "E": 90, "S": 180, "W": 270}

if rb in directions:
    print(directions[rb])
else:
    cardinal = rb[0] + rb[-1]
    angle = int(rb[1:-1])

    match cardinal:
        case "NE":
            print(angle)
        case "SE":
            print(180 - angle)
        case "SW":
            print(180 + angle)
        case "NW":
            print(360 - angle)
data.statement: Create a program that converts a given Reduced Bearing (RB) (angular measurement) into its corresponding Whole Circle Bearing (WCB) notation. The input would clearly state the quadrant direction (NθE, NθW, SθE, SθW) or the cardinal direction (N, E, S, W) if it falls exactly on a boundary (e.g. 90).
data.constraints:
Angle < 90
[[rb]] is shorter than 4 characters
Cardinal_Start is always N/S
Cardinal_End is always E/W
data.inputDescription:
<<Line 1 :>> An string [[rb]] for the reduced bearing

For values between 0 and 90, 90 and 180, 180 and 270, and 270 and 360, the format will be: [Cardinal_Start][Angle][Cardinal_End] (e.g., S45E).

For cardinal points (0, 90, 180, 270), there will only be the direction (e.g., E). Note that N should translate to 0 degree.
data.outputDescription: <<Line 1:>> An integer [[wcb]] for the whole circle bearing

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Create a program that converts a given Reduced Bearing (RB) (angular measurement) into its corresponding Whole Circle Bearing (WCB) notation. The input would clearly state the quadrant direction (NθE, NθW, SθE, SθW) or the cardinal direction (N, E, S, W) if it falls exactly on a boundary (e.g. 90).
Input
Line 1 : An string rb for the reduced bearing

For values between 0 and 90, 90 and 180, 180 and 270, and 270 and 360, the format will be: [Cardinal_Start][Angle][Cardinal_End] (e.g., S45E).

For cardinal points (0, 90, 180, 270), there will only be the direction (e.g., E). Note that N should translate to 0 degree.
Output
Line 1: An integer wcb for the whole circle bearing
Constraints
Angle < 90
rb is shorter than 4 characters
Cardinal_Start is always N/S
Cardinal_End is always E/W
Example
Input
N45E
Output
45
